Each lifecycle environment of the generative AI system should have its own distinct accounts and secrets. This means that user accounts, administrative accounts, and any secrets (such as API keys or passwords) should be separate for each environment (training, deployment, and production) to ensure security and prevent lateral movement between environments.

GPU hardware may be shared between multiple AI models only if those models correspond to the same level of sensitivity and have homogeneous security needs. Otherwise, it is recommended to dedicate GPU components specifically to the AI system to prevent potential data leaks.
